promotion_window_opens_before_it_closes.name: promotion_window_opens_before_it_closes
promotion_window_opens_before_it_closes.value:
"promotion"."valid_from" is null or "promotion"."valid_to" is null
        or "promotion"."valid_to" >= "promotion"."valid_from"

booking_revokes_anonymous_access_only_wi.name: booking_revokes_anonymous_access_only_with_an_account
booking_revokes_anonymous_access_only_wi.value: "booking"."anon_access_revoked_at" is null or "booking"."user_id" is not null

booking_quoted_promotion_reduces_within_.name: booking_quoted_promotion_reduces_within_its_scale
booking_quoted_promotion_reduces_within_.value:
"booking"."quoted_promotion_type" is null
        or ("booking"."quoted_promotion_type" = 'PERCENTAGE' and "booking"."quoted_promotion_value" between -99 and -1)
        or ("booking"."quoted_promotion_type" = 'FIXED_AMOUNT' and "booking"."quoted_promotion_value" < 0)

system_config_reduced_vat_window_opens_b.name: system_config_reduced_vat_window_opens_before_it_closes
system_config_reduced_vat_window_opens_b.value:
"system_config"."reduced_vat_from" is null or "system_config"."reduced_vat_to" is null
        or "system_config"."reduced_vat_to" >= "system_config"."reduced_vat_from"

folio_posting_sign_matches_type.name: folio_posting_sign_matches_type
folio_posting_sign_matches_type.value:
case "folio_posting"."type"
        when 'PAYMENT' then "folio_posting"."amount" <= 0
        when 'REVERSAL' then true
        else "folio_posting"."amount" >= 0
      end

payment_discrepancy_amounts_are_positive.name: payment_discrepancy_amounts_are_positive
payment_discrepancy_amounts_are_positive.value:
("payment_discrepancy"."gateway_amount" is null or "payment_discrepancy"."gateway_amount" > 0)
        and ("payment_discrepancy"."ledger_amount" is null or "payment_discrepancy"."ledger_amount" > 0)

payment_discrepancy_kind_matches_the_sid.name: payment_discrepancy_kind_matches_the_sides
payment_discrepancy_kind_matches_the_sid.value:
case "payment_discrepancy"."kind"
        when 'MISSING_LOCALLY' then
          "payment_discrepancy"."gateway_amount" is not null
            and "payment_discrepancy"."ledger_amount" is null
            and "payment_discrepancy"."payment_id" is null
        when 'MISSING_AT_GATEWAY' then
          "payment_discrepancy"."gateway_amount" is null
            and "payment_discrepancy"."ledger_amount" is not null
            and "payment_discrepancy"."payment_id" is not null
        when 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH' then
          "payment_discrepancy"."gateway_amount" is not null
            and "payment_discrepancy"."ledger_amount" is not null
            and "payment_discrepancy"."payment_id" is not null
            and "payment_discrepancy"."gateway_amount" <> "payment_discrepancy"."ledger_amount"
      end

audit_entry_states_present.name: audit_entry_states_present
audit_entry_states_present.value: "audit_entry"."before" is not null or "audit_entry"."after" is not null

audit_entry_action_matches_states.name: audit_entry_action_matches_states
